instruction: Songs of which genre have I liked the most in my Spotify playlists?
notes: Read-only question task (evaluation requires no DB changes). Playlists, playlist songs and the answer genre are unknown before any API call, so they are modeled as representative objects (my-playlist, playlist-song, most-liked-genre) discovered by lookup actions: show_playlist_library yields playlist ids, show_playlist yields the songs of each playlist, show_liked_songs yields which songs are liked, and show_song yields the genre of each liked playlist song; at runtime the agent repeats show_playlist/show_song per playlist/song and tallies genres. found-most-liked-genre captures the aggregated result, which is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, structurally forced to be the last action.
